items.title: Overview of the current list of Contracts Report for agenda items submitted for this scheduled BCC meeting.
Warrant list
Contracts and claims settlements list
Receive and file two FP&L agreements for street lighting in Districts 2 and 6.
Receive and file the Sky Chefs cargo building lease for aviation catering storage and equipment.
Receive and file a $10 million FAA grant for Concourse B Expansion Phase 2B and approve a budget amendment.
Approve EXP Amendment No. 5 for $619,088.40 in terminal and concourse modernization services.
Receive and file Suffolk Change Orders Nos. 6, 7 and 8 for Concourse B expansion.
Extend the FDOT airport access roadway rehabilitation grant through December 31, 2026.
Extend the FDOT air cargo roadway improvements grant through February 8, 2027.
Reappoint Mark Feldmesser to the Contract Review Committee and waive the consecutive- meeting absence provision.
Approve a $107,164 settlement of two Jorge L. Garcia code compliance liens.
Receive and file the Health Care District agreement transferring remaining Local Provider Participation Fund funds to the County.
Receive and file property-use licenses for FoundCare mobile health services and PBSO vehicle washing.
Approve FP&L underground utilities conversion agreement for the 45th Street Complex.
Ratify a $1,007,228.74 emergency archaeological services contract for Cam D. Milani Park.
Approve a five-year lease with Digital Vibez at Lake Lytal Park for youth enrichment and fitness programs.
Approve a $253,470 FWC contract for Lake Worth Lagoon oyster monitoring through May 30, 2030.
Receive and file the AEG Presents rental agreement for the Slightly Stoopid concert at Sunset Cove Amphitheater.
Receive and file the $1,240 Sanderford Sound production agreement for the Slightly Stoopid concert.
Receive and file amendments increasing funding for three water aerobics and swim Coaching agreements.
Ratify a $154,541 grant application for two handheld gas identification monitors and delegate grant administration authority.
Ratify a $187,472.25 grant application for ten bunker gear washer/extractor machines and delegate grant administration authority.
Approve a $5.35 million capital budget transfer for Fire Stations 16A and 16B.
Receive and file nine Learn to Swim Program agreements through September 30, 2029.
Approve a ten-year emergency services mutual assistance agreement with the City of Boca Raton.
Receive and file FY 2025–2026 third-quarter and contract management variance reports.
Appoint Mark Dorestin, Sean Brammer and Adam McMichael to the Criminal Justice Commission.
Approve a $19,000 ANDRUS trauma-informed care recertification contract and a $7,625 budget transfer.
Approve a $561,350 Prime Time contract for middle and high school expanded learning opportunities.
Extend the FY 2024 Operation Stonegarden grant through June 30, 2027.
Extend the FY 2023 Operation Stonegarden grant through June 30, 2027.
Accept a $396,000 FY 2025 Operation Stonegarden grant and approve a budget amendment.
Extend the Connect and Protect behavioral health response grant through September 30, 2027.
Accept a $218,500 FY 2024 State Homeland Security Grant for Fusion Center staffing, overtime, training and software technology, and approve a budget amendment.
Accept the $625,000 Forensic Genetic Testing Phase 2 award and approve a budget amendment.
Accept $303,000 in TSA explosives detection canine funding and approve a budget amendment.
Approve a $195,557.52 Stebbins eminent domain settlement for Parcels 125/325, including fees and costs.
Approve a $128,703.64 Stebbins eminent domain settlement for Parcels 127/327, including fees and costs.
Approve Morganti Amendment No. 2 for $18,768,500 in terminal modernization work, a contract renewal and a $9,300,944, $3,000,000, budget transfer.
Provide direction on JET GREENE's proposed $30 million airport property purchase and second fixed base operation lease.
Approve preliminary reading of Local Provider Participation Fund ordinance amendments and advertise a November 17 public hearing.
Authorize up to $42 million in Airport System Revenue Refunding Bonds, Series 2026.
Approve a $150,000 Space Connect agreement for BuildLocal business development and contract readiness services.
Approve five security officer positions and a $271,764 budget transfer for staffing, equipment and security upgrades.
Approve preliminary reading of the Micromobility Device Ordinance and advertise a December 1 public hearing.
Approve preliminary reading of Property Maintenance Code amendments.
Approve preliminary reading of contractor regulation amendments addressing penalties, enforcement authority and administrative updates.
Approve CSC youth program funding agreements, increased Greenacres teen program funding and a budget adjustment following termination of the Children's Home Society contract.

source_note: Items and titles transcribed from the official agenda (table of contents or order of business). Agendas list what was scheduled, not what was decided; votes are not in agendas.
